content: Kiara Sen inquired about physiotherapy coverage after knee surgery and was informed that up to 20 sessions per year are covered with a 20% co-pay. Neha Kapoor agreed to send a physio claim template and a copy of the policy PDF. Kiara also asked how to add her spouse as a dependent, and Neha provided the options to use the portal or send the required details for assistance.

action_items: Neha to send physio claim template
Kiara to provide spouse's full name, DOB, and ID to add as a dependent
